neighbours.label: The last word of a formal multiword name or technical term (agency and institution names, chemical names, measurement techniques, a currency), whether or not an acronym follows
fire: Researchers used infrared absorption spectroscopy to study the coating.
The Food and Drug Administration approved the new vaccine.
The official currency of Italy is the Euro, which replaced the lira.
The Federal Aviation Administration grounded the aircraft.
Levels of sulphur dioxide fell after the plant closed.
The European Space Agency launched a new satellite.
Engineers checked the air traffic control system at the airport.
The lab measured the mitochondrial membrane potential of each cell.
quiet: Researchers used a simple light test to study the coating.
The government doctors approved the new vaccine.
The shops in Italy accept cash, which many tourists prefer.
The airline grounded the aircraft after the storm.
Levels of smoke fell after the plant closed.
A private company launched a new satellite.
Engineers checked the old radio equipment at the airport.
The lab measured the size and shape of each cell.

notes: Probe: 'the Euro' 1.08, 'spectroscopy' 0.48, 'Protection Agency' 0.38, 'Health Organization' 0.32, 'nitrogen dioxide' 0.29, 'Central Bank' 0.24, with identical scores with or without the bracketed acronym (as expected for a causal model); plain sentence 0.02. Near misses keep the topic but use an informal description.
